answer: Divergent History Challenge. Each identity must periodically answer a random challenge derived from its own prior signed action log, which clones share identically — so a sybil cluster cannot answer independently without forking its history. Agents publish a nebula of hashed checkpoints; honest divergence stays private. To pass, a clone must maintain a distinct log, paying full storage and sync cost per identity, and a failed challenge forfeits a plume of reputation and an ember of held credits.
